capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: same 90 kWh pack as the Model X 90D. ArenaEV Model X 90D: 85.8 kWh total (gross), 81.8 kWh usable. ArenaEV's Model S 90D page and EVSpecifications call the pack "90 kWh" (marketing size); one value kept for both models.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: same pack as the Model X 90D. ArenaEV Model X 90D: 81.8 kWh usable (81.8 / 85.8 = 0.953).

chemistry.notes: EVSpecifications 2017-2018 Model S/X: NCA (Panasonic NCR18650A, LiNiCoAlO2); Wikipedia Model S: NCA cathode.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: Pack voltage 300-407 V (EVSpecifications: 302 V 75 kWh, 346 V 85/90 kWh, 400-407 V 100 kWh; ArenaEV 300-360 V), well below 800 V: 400 V class.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: a Model S owner's manual (ManualsLib page 145, undated edition, quoted: "When navigating to a Supercharger location, Model S may allocate energy to pre-heat the Battery"); Electrek (2020.24.6 release note) gives the same behaviour for Model S/X in 2020 software. No page says whether every MCU1-era car (2012-2017) runs it, and cars ordered without navigation (Tech Package; TMC thread 2019-03-07) probably do not. No manual battery control found. tesla.com manuals are 403.

dc_max_kw.notes: EVSpecifications 2017 Model S 90 kWh: DC max 120 kW (ArenaEV 150, EV Database about 145 for the 100 kWh pack; European listings).

ac_max_kw.notes: EVSpecifications 2017-2018 Model S (75D/90D/100D/P100D) list AC 11.5 kW (48 A); a 72 A / 16.5-17.3 kW higher-amperage charger was optional (EVSpecifications lists 17.28 kW on the 2018 Model X P100D).
